description: Golden I — site spawning + succession mechanics (Z4). Zero-player-action run 2025→2031: Jim Bridger (56037, 2120 MW coal) retires on schedule → site spawns in Sweetwater County. On-site SMR vs greenfield SMR demonstrates the succession discount triple (TTD-2yr, 15% capex, TX waiver). coal_to_smr convert path: TX waiver only (no TTD/capex — brownfield premium already in $8,500,000/MW). Workforce pool decays to 148.4 FTE at 2041. Digests at 2031 are IDENTICAL to Golden G′ (site assets excluded from all three digest domains).
digest_stability_note: state_digest, fiscal_digest, and existing_assets_digest at 2031 match Golden G′ byte-for-byte. Site assets are excluded from all three digest serializations. 2041 digests cover workforce pool decay only — no player actions in this fixture.

digests_yr2031.note: Identical to Golden G′ at 2031. Site assets excluded from all three digest domains.

digests_yr2041.note: Covers 10 years of PRB autonomous coal decline + workforce pool decay (no player actions).
